programs.name: Bachelor International Business Administration (IBA)
programs.requirementsText:
Mathematics requirement

Mathematics Analysis & Approaches SL minimum grade 5 OR Mathematics Analysis & Approaches HL minimum grade 4 OR Mathematics Applications & Interpretation HL minimum grade 5 

English language requirement

You are exempt from the English language test if you have obtained or will obtain the IB diploma AND the final two years of the IB programme were fully taught in English.

You will be granted selection points if you have a total of 33 points based on the 6 exam subjects (excluding TOK and EE) or higher.

---
As a numerux fixus programme, IBA applicants are given selection points, which are used for ranking and selecting the top 750 applicants. The selection points are based on your grades and your motivation;
Grades 75%: Your average grade counts the most for the final ranking. The lower your grades, the fewer selection points you'll receive.
Motivation 25%: You will answer 3 motivation questions when applying.
You must also meet the minimum English and Mathematics requirements listed for your diploma type.
programs.notes:
Numerus fixus – výběr podle známek (75 %) a motivace (25 %). Sloučeno se zdvojeným řádkem 22.

programs.name: International Business Administration BSc
programs.requirementsText:
Tilburg University only accepts the full International Baccalaureate Diploma, which includes the core (Theory of Knowledge, Extended Essay and CAS) and subjects taken from groups 1-5 or groups 1-6 - of which at least three subjects must be at Higher Level. The overall score must be ≥ 24. Individual diploma program course results are not accepted for admission purposes. 
Please note: Predicted grades are not used for the evaluation. Your school needs to list your IB courses clearly on your grade reports. The subjects you plan to take for your IB exams should correspond with the IB courses on your grade reports and the TiU Statement of Educational Institution form. Ensure your school provides the subject names and levels, including languages and mathematics courses (Analysis & Approaches SL/HL or Applications & Interpretation SL/HL).
programs.notes: Predicted grades se nepoužívají – rozhoduje finální diplom.
